[{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Hi Amanda, it's good to see you online. How have you been doing lately?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Hey! I've been feeling a bit off after attending my aunt's memorial service last week."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm sorry to hear that. It must have been an emotional experience for you."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yeah, it really was. Not only because we were saying goodbye, but also because I got to see so many relatives I hadn't seen in years."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds like it brought up a lot of feelings. How did that affect you?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It was bittersweet. On one hand, it was wonderful to reconnect, but on the other hand, it made me realize how distant I've become from them."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It sounds like you're processing a mix of emotions—grief and perhaps some regret?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Exactly. I feel guilty for not staying in touch more. It was strange talking about memories with people I used to be so close to."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's understandable. Guilt can be hard to shake off, but reconnecting at the memorial could be a new beginning."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I hope so. I exchanged numbers with a few of them and promised to keep in touch."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's a great step forward. How does it feel to have taken that initiative?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"A little reassuring, honestly. But there's still this nagging feeling of having missed out on so much with them."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's natural to feel that way, but it's important to give yourself grace. Every relationship has its own timeline."}]
</quoted_conversation_context>
